scope: SDK automatically assembles ReAct, Planner and Executor instructions from business-only definitions. Workflow excluded. A reproducible maintenance shutdown race exposed by regression is also fixed.
implementation: Versioned templates and per-role final-output / executor-input contracts in the prompts package; business configuration needs no new system-prompt field.
Private executor business prompts and variable defaults are not advertised to Planner; default variable type inference is shared with validation.
Admission stores all role instructions; later root and child creation and recovery use the saved snapshot. Legacy Runs keep their original layout.
Fixed SDK instruction records reject both Hook patch routes, survive compaction, and participate in token budgeting.
Runtime maintenance cancels each scanner once and retrieves all outcomes after draining in-flight threads.

focused_mode_schema_history.note: Passed before the maintenance shutdown fix; the final regression covers those cases on the final source.

existing_assertion_updates: agentloom-sdk/tests/test_hook_context_contract.py: select protected user input explicitly; branch on tool feedback instead of total message count.
agentloom-sdk/tests/test_execution_contract.py: select the first Planner decision by absence of tool feedback.
agentloom-sdk/qa/test_sdk_audit.py: locate the user input by role instead of index 1.

maintenance_failure.explanation: Propagating cancellation through gather and then canceling the scanners again interrupts their thread-drain await. The old host can return closed before its maintenance scan finishes; the gated tests reproduce both scanner branches on both stores.

independent_probe.note: Independently authored work remains untouched and is excluded from the established regression scope.

validation_limits: Deterministic models, local HTTP transports, existing MCP protocol tests and real local subprocess exits. No live LLM behavior evaluation, remote MCP, cross-machine persistence or Workflow validation.
evidence_notes: Exploratory focused and full runs were interrupted by macOS maintenance sleeps; logs and sleep-interruption.json are preserved. The final regression ran under process-scoped caffeinate -is, without changing SDK lease or timeout semantics.

The full regression before the shutdown fix had one real existing failure. Four gated shutdown tests then failed deterministically and passed after the fix; the original test deadline was not relaxed.

An intermediate installed-package check exposed an unretrieved aggregate cancellation. wheel-shutdown-resume.json preserves it; the final host drains scanners and explicitly retrieves the aggregate outcome. The subprocess recovery test now also requires empty stderr.
Two partial regressions were intentionally stopped while refining private-default isolation and shutdown outcome retrieval; their logs are separately named and are not final results.
